propositions: Process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies, resulting in three identical cache fills under -n 3 --dist worksteal instead of one serial fill

Three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute pass-1 renders that are bit-for-bit identical to values already cached by _rendered(), duplicating work within the test suite

Cross-worker session-scoped artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus files, renderer source, and pandoc executable reduces per-worker cache fills from three to one and eliminates pass-1 recomputation in fixed-point tests

Sharded per-stratum artifact with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order allows concurrent workers to fill different strata without queueing on the same shard, reducing cold-session wall time from full corpus to one stratum
Atomic filesystem locks with 150s fallback deadline enable losers to render locally without deadlock if winner crashes, ensuring all runs complete within 300s timeout guard
